source_inventory.document: Learning Outcomes at the Foundational Stage
source_inventory.publisher: NCERT (logo and name on back cover)
source_inventory.year: NOT_CONFIRMED (PDF metadata created 2025-08-26; cites NCERT 2024 materials)
source_inventory.pages_analyzed: All 73 PDF pages; CG-8 (PDF 24-34), Hindi language section (PDF 35-43, read from page images), English L2 (PDF 49-52). Urdu section (PDF 44-48) inventoried only.
source_inventory.relevance: Primary source for grade-wise (Grade 1, Grade 2) literacy and numeracy outcomes, mapped to NCF-FS curricular goals and competencies.
source_inventory.limitations: No Grade 3. Hindi text uses a non-Unicode font (read visually from page images). Urdu section not extracted. C-10.9 Grade 1/2 cells duplicate C-10.8. CG-8 numbering differs from NCF-FS and is internally inconsistent.

source_inventory.document: National Curriculum Framework for Foundational Stage (NCF-FS) 2022
source_inventory.publisher: National Steering Committee for National Curriculum Frameworks; submitted to the Ministry of Education (Foreword)
source_inventory.pages_analyzed: Contents (9-10); Ch.2 definitions (49-69, targeted); Section 4.5 literacy and numeracy strategies (112-122); Annexure 1 CG-8 to CG-11 (246-266); Annexure 3 NIPUN-NCF competency mapping (325-334).
source_inventory.relevance: Defines curricular goals, competencies and illustrative learning-outcome trajectories; corroborates LO-document outcomes; supplies pedagogy/example activities.
source_inventory.limitations: Annexure 1 columns A-E cover ages 3-8 as a continuum and are NOT labelled by grade, so NCF-only outcomes cannot be grade-assigned. Chapters 3, 5-10 and Annexure 2 were not fully extracted.

source_inventory.document: Vidya Pravesh - Three-month Play-based School Preparation Module for Grade-I
source_inventory.pages_analyzed: Front matter (1-12); Part II Goal 2 and Goal 3 activities (56-85, targeted); Annexure I outcomes (166-170).
source_inventory.relevance: Grade 1 entry (first 12 weeks) school-readiness outcomes and named play-based activities for literacy and numeracy.
source_inventory.limitations: Outcomes are labelled 'Preschool 3 - Balvatika' though transacted in Grade-I. IL3.16-3.19 and IL3.24 missing from listing. Two-column layout; worksheets (Part III) and Annexures II-VIII not extracted.
